notes: Tier+Tactical Melee Extended (Kai): eleven melee weapons that hit along a short ray from the eye with their TT_raycast fields, each swing drawing one of its pair of hit sounds as its onFire did, its arm and other-arm moves played by the states that ran them. The Combat Knife stabs on a quick click and slashes once charged, the slash dealing 100 (Kai set 105, which the raycast script held to 100) and the stab 55. A hit never crits: TT_isMeleeRaycastCrit crits only on a zombie, and no player in this game is one. The Machete's horizontal swing (Weapon_L4BMachete_HorizontalSwing.cs) is never loaded by the Add-On.
